purpose: Find whether cross-seed split/merge incompatibility can be repaired by compact joint native groups anchored to source-only features.
scope: Exposed natural discovery8192 and calibration4096 tokens, one shared seed edge, two controlled SAE mechanisms. Source anchors selected solely from source activity and energy quantiles. Joint groups fit actual nonnegative zero-ablation contributions, with independent mean/Phi reported separately. Soft gates in[0,1], anchor fixed1, bounded convex quadratic and standard L-BFGS-B. Calibration is development feedback, not fresh confirmation. Group correspondence error is not yet a measured finite model effect or semantic certificate. Best-atom comparator applies to exactly the same learned source group; anchored-atom comparison changes source granularity and is reported as such.
